## Purpose

This appendix is generated from `../generated-schema-register.csv` and `../generated-variable-crosswalk.csv`. It is a variable-by-variable evidence table for current `fplida` output.

The observed values/distributions are generated-output evidence, not official source-data calibration. Official codebooks and source documentation in the parent guide still take precedence.
